about: feat-platform-10: the one description of every action form's fields, read by the browser (actionforms.js imports it) and by the dashboard's server (core::drive embeds it), so a step Claude sends and a click Kenny makes are checked against the same words. {stack}, {expect}, {label} and {text} are filled in by both sides the same way. show_when: a field is on screen, checked and sent only while another field has that value ('says' is when, in words); change_when: its label, help and required while another field has that value.

force.label: Deploy anyway (force)
force.help: The host last deployed a commit this working copy does not have; forcing replaces that deploy with these files.

confirm.label: Type {stack} to confirm
confirm.help: The name of the stack, exactly; this cannot be undone from the dashboard.

list_only.label: Type {stack} to delete for real
list_only.help: Leave it empty and the wipe only lists what it would delete.

snapshot.label: Snapshot
snapshot.help: A restic snapshot id from the backup page; empty takes the latest.

app.label: App
app.help: Update one app, or every app of the stack.

help_for.restore: Restore one app's data, or every app of the stack.

unit.label: Native unit
unit.help: The service whose previous binary goes back; the stack's updates are parked after it.

help_for.install-native: The service to install; a stack with one service has only that one.

skip_backup.label: Skip the backup before destroying
skip_backup.help: Without it the container's data is backed up first.

help_for.apply: Without it each stack destroyed here is backed up first.

skip_safety_copy.label: Skip the safety copy of the current data
skip_safety_copy.help: Without it the data as it is now is kept aside before the restore.

secret_ref.label: Secret
secret_ref.help: Which secret, picked on the stack's Secrets page — type it by hand only when you already have its exact JSON.

stage_token.label: Staged value token
stage_token.help: The Secrets page stages the new value and fills this in itself; it is never the value.

commit.label: Commit
commit.help: The stack's files as they were at this commit are deployed.

vmid.label: Container number
vmid.help: The container's vmid, e.g. 105; the host refuses the ones on its no-touch list.

help_for.template-build: A free vmid the build uses and then turns into the template, e.g. 994.

command.label: Command
command.help: One line, run as root inside the container; the host writes it to its audit log (secrets in it are masked by shape only).

tag.label: Release tag
tag.help: The GitHub releases of this repository, newest first; an unsigned one (no SHA256SUMS.minisig yet) is listed but cannot be chosen.

help_for.install-native: The service's release to install, from its own repository's releases; an unsigned one cannot be chosen.

version.label: Template version
version.help: The number after -homelab-v in the template's name: the next one, e.g. 5 when v4 is the newest.

privileged.label: Privileged template
privileged.help: The second template, for the stacks that must stay privileged (CT 105 and 106); a clone cannot change it.

base.label: Base OS
base.help: The OS template to bake, from the host's list; empty: the host's default.

check.label: Check
check.help: The manual check to answer, from the checks page.

verdict.label: Answer
verdict.help: ok, not ok, or not ok accepted for a number of days (then the days and the reason are asked).

choices.label: not ok, accepted for some days

days.label: Number of days
days.help: How many days this not ok counts as accepted, 1 to 3650.

show_when.says: the answer is "not ok, accepted for some days"

change_when.label: Reason
change_when.help: Required with this answer: one line on why this not ok is accepted.

destroy.label: Destroy these gone stacks
destroy.help: The plan lists the stacks whose directory is gone. Type the name of each one to destroy, comma-separated; empty: nothing is destroyed.

messages.typed_wrong: That is not {expect}; type the stack's name exactly.

edit.about: feat-platform-10: the edit forms (stack settings, the raw editor, add an app, the firewall and its rule dialog, the plan dialog's commit step, the new-stack wizard, a host.toml key, the batch and roll back dialogs), described once. editforms.js draws them from here and core::driveedit checks a driven step against the same words. {label}, {lower}, {min}, {max}, {expect}, {text}, {stack}, {key}, {name}, {vmid}, {peer}, {part} are filled in the same way on both sides.

messages.number: {label} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
messages.subject: A commit needs a subject.
messages.raw_unchanged: The file is as it was.
messages.name_taken: There is a stack called {name} already.
messages.peer_form: {peer} is not an address like 10.10.10.4 or a network like 10.10.10.0/24.
messages.peer_host_bits: {peer} has host bits set: Proxmox reads it as the whole network. Write one address, or the network.
messages.icmp_ports: icmp has no ports; clear them.
messages.port_proto: A port needs tcp or udp.
messages.port_range: {part} is not a port 1 to 65535 or a forward range.
messages.key_window: A number and a unit, e.g. 24h.
messages.rollback_choose: Choose a commit to deploy or a unit to roll back.
messages.tile_down_low: {key}: down after ({down} s) must be at least check every ({watch} s).
messages.retention_json: A JSON list of {"every_days": N, "span_days": N} (span_days optional).
messages.retention_not_json: Not valid JSON: a list like [] or [{"every_days": 1, "span_days": 7}].
messages.dollar_expand: must not contain '${': latch --expand parses every file it is given, so one unresolvable placeholder would break every stack's secrets, not only this one's.

follow.deploy: Commit, then deploy exactly this commit
follow.resize: Commit, then resize the running container

settings.name: cores
settings.label: Cores
settings.help: CPU cores the container may use.

settings.name: memory_mb
settings.label: Memory (MB)
settings.help: Memory limit; raising it takes a Resize, lowering it a rebuild.

settings.name: disk_gb
settings.label: Disk (GB)
settings.help: Root disk size; Proxmox can grow a disk, never shrink it.

settings.name: onboot
settings.label: Start on boot
settings.help: Whether the container starts when pve starts (the deploy puts it back, W3).

settings.name: order
settings.label: Boot order
settings.help: Lower starts earlier; everything behind the edge waits for Traefik.

settings.name: protection
settings.label: Proxmox protection
settings.help: Refuses a destroy at the hypervisor; a rebuild applies a change.

settings_ext.name: ip
settings_ext.label: Address (CIDR)
settings_ext.help: The container's own address, e.g. 10.10.10.10/24. Checked against every other stack's address before the commit.

settings_ext.name: gateway
settings_ext.label: Gateway
settings_ext.help: The router's address on this VLAN, e.g. 10.10.10.1.

settings_ext.name: bridge
settings_ext.label: Bridge
settings_ext.help: The Proxmox bridge this container's NIC attaches to, e.g. vmbr0.

settings_ext.name: vlan
settings_ext.label: VLAN tag
settings_ext.help: Blank leaves the tag as it is.

settings_ext.name: unprivileged
settings_ext.label: Unprivileged
settings_ext.help: Only takes effect at a rebuild of the container (pct create/clone sets it once); a deploy never changes a running container's privilege level.

settings_ext.name: gpu
settings_ext.label: GPU passthrough
settings_ext.help: Passes /dev/dri in. Only takes effect at a rebuild.

settings_ext.name: vpn
settings_ext.label: VPN device
settings_ext.help: Gives the container /dev/net/tun. Only takes effect at a rebuild.

settings_ext.name: timezone
settings_ext.label: Timezone
settings_ext.help: Passed to pct create --timezone; "host" inherits the Proxmox host's timezone. Only takes effect at a rebuild.

settings_ext.name: storage
settings_ext.label: Proxmox storage
settings_ext.help: The pve storage id the root disk lives on, e.g. local-lvm. Only takes effect at a rebuild.

settings_ext.name: on_demand
settings_ext.label: On demand
settings_ext.help: A stack created and destroyed in one sitting, like a drill; the fleet check does not report it as declared-but-never-deployed.

retention_tier.name: every_days
retention_tier.label: Keep one every
retention_tier.help: A snapshot is kept from every span of this many days.

retention_tier.name: span_days
retention_tier.label: For
retention_tier.help: How long this tier's snapshots are kept; blank means forever (only the last tier may be left blank).

image.name: image:{key}
image.label: Image of {key}
image.help: The image reference in the app's compose file, e.g. name:1.2.3.

tile_watch.name: tile_watch_every:{key}
tile_watch.label: Check every (seconds) · {key}
tile_watch.help: How often this tile is probed. Blank uses the fleet default (host settings watch_interval_s, 60 s).

tile_down.name: tile_down_after:{key}
tile_down.label: Down after (seconds) · {key}
tile_down.help: How long without a good probe before this tile shows down. Blank uses the fleet default (host settings watch_down_after_s, 300 s); must be at least the check interval.

commit.name: subject
commit.label: Commit subject
commit.help: The first line of the commit; a feature id in brackets is added when it names none.

commit.name: note
commit.label: Why (optional)
commit.help: A sentence for the commit body: why this changes.

commit.name: follow
commit.label: After the commit
commit.help: A deploy goes through the Jobs queue with its progress; it deploys this very commit.

raw.name: op
raw.label: What to do
raw.help: Edit an existing file's text, create a new one, delete one, or rename one.

raw.name: file
raw.label: File
raw.help: Anything the form does not cover. Secrets (.env) are not here: they live in latch. For create, this is ignored.

raw.name: text
raw.label: The file's text
raw.help: The whole file as it should be; homelab ui edit raw-text <file> sets it. For create, the new file's starting text.

raw.name: new_path
raw.label: New path
raw.help: Where the created file goes, relative to the stack's directory (op: create).

raw.name: rename_to
raw.label: Rename to
raw.help: The file's new path, relative to the stack's directory (op: rename).

add_app.name: preset
add_app.label: Preset
add_app.help: A preset's app joins this stack: its files, its entry in apps and its /appdata folder.

native.name: unit
native.label: Unit
native.help: Which native unit of this stack service.yml below edits.

native.name: binary
native.label: Binary
native.help: The absolute path of the installed program inside the container.

native.name: env_file
native.label: Environment file
native.help: The unit's EnvironmentFile; empty clears it.

native.name: update_cmd
native.label: Update command
native.help: Empty: the homelab runs no verb of its own for this service.

native.name: restore_note
native.label: Restore note
native.help: Printed in the DR runbook under this unit.

native.name: release_repo
native.label: Release repo
native.help: owner/name on GitHub; empty means adopted only.

native.name: backup_from_newest
native.label: Backup from newest
native.help: An absolute glob with a '*', e.g. /appdata/…/backup-*.db.

native.name: backup_pause
native.label: Pause for the nightly backup
native.help: false: no quiescing. true: the homelab stops/starts the unit itself. chassis: the chassis-rs kit's own backup-pause/backup-resume, falling back to stop/start when it cannot.

choices.label: Chassis kit (backup-pause, falls back to stop)

native.name: update_policy
native.label: Update policy
native.help: manual: never; auto: nightly release check; self: the unit's own update_cmd, nightly.

native.name: metrics
native.label: Metrics
native.help: Measured clears the key (the default); Not measured writes metrics: false.

add_native.name: unit
add_native.label: Unit name
add_native.help: The systemd unit name, without .service. Its service.yml and unit file go under <unit>/.

add_native.name: binary
add_native.label: Binary
add_native.help: The absolute path of the program inside the container.

firewall.name: enabled
firewall.label: In force (the deploy writes the file and switches firewall=1 on the network card)

firewall.name: policy_in
firewall.label: Inbound policy
firewall.help: What happens when no inbound rule matches.

firewall.name: policy_out
firewall.label: Outbound policy
firewall.help: What happens when no outbound rule matches.

firewall.name: management_open
firewall.label: Management network open, because…
firewall.help: Empty: DNS to the router only, the rest of 10.10.5.0/24 dropped. A reason drops that guard.

firewall.name: comment
firewall.label: Comment at the top of the file
firewall.help: Lines written above the rules in pve's file.

rule.name: dir
rule.label: Direction
rule.help: In: who may reach this container. Out: where it may go.

rule.name: action
rule.label: Action
rule.help: The first rule that matches decides; the policy applies when none does.

rule.name: peer
rule.label: Other side
rule.help: One address (10.10.10.4) or a network (10.10.10.0/24); empty: anywhere.

rule.name: proto
rule.label: Protocol
rule.help: A port needs tcp or udp; icmp has no ports.

rule.name: note
rule.label: Note
rule.help: One line, written after the rule in pve's file (who this is for).

rule.name: comment
rule.label: Comment above the rule
rule.help: Optional lines written above the rule: why it exists.

apps_remove.name: apps-remove:{app}
apps_remove.label: {app}
apps_remove.help: Drops {app} from apps:, its directory, and any storage or data_mounts row naming it as app: — data already on the container is untouched.

apps_add_blank.name: add_blank
apps_add_blank.label: Add blank app(s), comma-separated
apps_add_blank.help: Each gets a directory and a minimal docker-compose.yml to fill in; no preset.

add_app_tile.name: add-app-tile:{app}
add_app_tile.label: {app} hostname
add_app_tile.help: Blank: no tile for this app. Named after the app, group "Own"; refine it afterward in the Tiles card.

storage_entry.name: host_path
storage_entry.label: Host path
storage_entry.help: Under /appdata/, named <app>-config; the owning app keeps its own backup history across a move (D25).

storage_entry.name: mount_point
storage_entry.label: Mount point
storage_entry.help: Where it appears inside the container.

storage_entry.name: app
storage_entry.label: Owning app
storage_entry.help: The restic repository is named after this app; empty: the stack itself owns it.

storage_entry.name: no_data
storage_entry.label: No data (this app keeps nothing of its own on disk)

storage_entry.name: no_backup
storage_entry.label: No backup, because…
storage_entry.help: Empty: backed up normally. A reason here deliberately stops the backup (Z3).

storage_entry.name: host_owner_uid
storage_entry.label: Host owner uid
storage_entry.help: Empty: the fleet default appdata owner.

data_mount.name: host_path
data_mount.label: Host path
data_mount.help: A directory on the Proxmox host this stack only borrows (media libraries): never created, never backed up. Must already exist.

data_mount.name: mount_point
data_mount.label: Mount point
data_mount.help: Frozen across a rebuild: every app config that points at this path depends on it.

data_mount.name: note
data_mount.label: Note
data_mount.help: Whose directory this is, for the next reader.

data_mount.name: rotate_files
data_mount.label: Rotate: file name or glob
data_mount.help: Empty: this mount's log is not rotated. Joined to the mount point, e.g. access.log or *.log.

data_mount.name: rotate_keep
data_mount.label: Rotate: copies kept
data_mount.help: Empty with a file name given: 14.

data_mount.name: rotate_container
data_mount.label: Rotate: tell this container
data_mount.help: docker kill --signal after the rename, so the app opens a new file rather than losing the copytruncate window. Empty: copytruncate.

data_mount.name: rotate_signal
data_mount.label: Rotate: signal
data_mount.help: Empty with a container given: USR1.

log_file.name: path
log_file.label: Path
log_file.help: Absolute path inside the container; a glob is allowed.

log_file.name: job
log_file.label: Job label
log_file.help: The `job` label its lines carry in Loki, e.g. access.

latch_secret.name: latch-secret:{app}
latch_secret.label: {app}
latch_secret.help: {app}'s .env comes from latch instead of a plaintext file.

latch_file.name: from
latch_file.label: From (in latch, under this stack)
latch_file.help: A relative path; latch holds it at <stack>/<from>.

latch_file.name: owner
latch_file.label: Owner
latch_file.help: user:group inside the container; empty: left as the file arrives.

latch_file.name: restarts
latch_file.label: Restarts this native unit
latch_file.help: Empty: nothing restarts when the file changes (a unit that reads it with EnvironmentFile= restarts anyway).

check_row.name: name
check_row.label: Name
check_row.help: Shown to Kenny: "films in the library", not a variable name.

check_row.name: command
check_row.label: Command
check_row.help: Run inside the container; its stdout, trimmed, is the reading.

check_row.name: layer
check_row.label: Layer
check_row.help: How deep this reading actually goes.

check_row.name: blind_spot
check_row.label: Blind spot
check_row.help: What this does NOT prove. Required below Application layer.

probe_row.name: command
probe_row.label: Command
probe_row.help: Run with sh -c; its stdout, trimmed, is the reading.

probe_row.name: blind_spot
probe_row.label: Blind spot
probe_row.help: What this does NOT prove. Required below Application layer.

checks_scalar.name: busy_check
checks_scalar.label: Busy check command
checks_scalar.help: Shell command run in the container; blank = none.

checks_scalar.name: url
checks_scalar.label: Link
checks_scalar.help: https://…; blank = derived from the route file.

tile_row.name: key
tile_row.label: Hostname
tile_row.help: What the tile opens at; renaming this hostname keeps the tile's history.

tile_row.name: group
tile_row.label: Group
tile_row.help: The heading it sits under; pick one already used or type a new one.

tile_row.name: watch_url
tile_row.label: Watch address
tile_row.help: Optional. The address the minute watch asks instead of the tile's own link, e.g. a health endpoint on the container's own address.

tile_row.name: reading
tile_row.label: Reading command
tile_row.help: Shell run in the container; its output shows on the tile.

tile_row.name: down_after
tile_row.label: Down after (seconds)
tile_row.help: Blank: the fleet default; must be at least check every.

publish.name: port
publish.label: Container port
publish.help: The port the app's own container answers on.

publish.name: external
publish.label: This backend is not one of the fleet's own managed stacks

publish.name: separate_file
publish.label: Keep this route in a file of its own (extra_routes) instead of adding to traefik-routes.yml

publish.name: create_tile
publish.label: Also create a tile for this hostname

fields.name: preset
fields.label: Start from
fields.help: A preset from the repository's presets/ directory: its apps, their compose files and a size.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Stack name
fields.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; it names the directory, the container and its data.

fields.name: swap_mb
fields.label: Swap (MB)
fields.help: Empty: a quarter of the memory, 512 MB to 2 GB.

fields.name: tile_hostname
fields.label: Hostname
fields.help: Where this stack's tile opens, e.g. recipes.kp-soft.dev. Blank: no tile is created.

fields.name: tile_name
fields.label: Name
fields.help: What the tile is called on the dashboard's start page. Blank: the stack's own name.

fields.name: tile_group
fields.label: Group
fields.help: The heading the tile sits under; an existing group or a new one.

fields.name: tile_description
fields.label: Description
fields.help: One line under the name. Blank: none.

fields.name: tile_watch_every
fields.label: Check every
fields.help: How often the dashboard's minute watch checks this tile, in seconds. Blank: the fleet default.

fields.name: tile_down_after
fields.label: Down after
fields.help: How long it may fail before it counts as down, in seconds. Blank: the fleet default.

nodata.name: nodata:{path}
nodata.label: {path} keeps nothing
nodata.help: Ticked: the app keeps no files of its own here, so it gets no backup repository (no_data). Leave it off when in doubt.

rollback.name: commit
rollback.label: Deploy an earlier commit
rollback.help: The stack's files as they were at this commit are deployed (the Deploy this button of its row).

rollback.name: unit
rollback.label: Native unit
rollback.help: The service whose previous binary goes back (the button of its row).

import.name: bundle
import.label: Bundle
import.help: The YAML an export wrote (Export bundle on a stack's page, or homelab export); it never carries secrets. homelab ui edit import-bundle <file> sets it.

import.name: name
import.label: New stack name
import.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; the bundle's own name, vmid, address and /appdata paths are replaced by the new ones.

import.name: vmid
import.label: Container number
import.help: The new vmid; its address becomes 10.10.10.<number − 100>.

new_preset_name.name: name
new_preset_name.label: Preset name
new_preset_name.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not starting with '_'.

preset_file.name: file
preset_file.label: File
preset_file.help: Empty: a new file, at the path below.

preset_file.name: path
preset_file.label: Path
preset_file.help: Relative to the preset's own directory, e.g. myapp/docker-compose.yml.

preset_file.name: template
preset_file.label: Start from
preset_file.help: A starter template's text, for a new file only.

preset_file.name: rename_to
preset_file.label: New path
preset_file.help: The selected file's new path, relative to the preset's own directory.
